description:
A new potion, useful for villagers

# Potion of Forgetfulness

## Brewing

A new potion can be brewed using Chorus Fruit. 
One chorus fruit will brew up to three awkward potions into 
potions of forgetfulness. Then these new potions can be brewed
by gunpowder to make splash potions of forgetfulness.
Each potion has different effects.


## Effects

A potion of forgetfulness can be drunk. When it is, it does 
not give the player any bonus or lasting effect. Rather, 
when it is drunk the player loses all memory of past
achievements, as if they never happened at all.

The splash potion of forgetfulness has a much different effect, 
however. When thrown, it will not appear to do anything at all. 
But on closer inspection, it will be seen that any job attuned 
villagers that were close enough to the brew will have forgotten 
what they were trading before and have to make a rough guess of
what to offer.
